claimed_purpose.text: Soul Memory is explicitly contrasted against standard vector-RAG, positioning it as an autonomous background agent rather than a retrieve-then-prompt system.

mechanisms.text: MEMORY.md is distinguished from USER.md by content focus: MEMORY.md holds the character's subjective psychology, beliefs, emotional decay, and internal tension; USER.md holds factual user attributes, preferences, habits, relationship dynamics, and shared milestones/promises.

Topic deduplication at create-time uses cosine similarity with a threshold of 0.82; if a sufficiently similar topic already exists, the create action is redirected to update that existing file instead.
Conflict/supersession: the system detects logical contradictions between new responses and past stored facts, automatically overwriting outdated information and logging corrections.
A dedicated 'Last Prompt' tab inside the Soul Memory archive exposes the raw prompt as constructed before sending to the backend, allowing inspection of injected blocks.
A rolling narrative summary ('summary_text') is persisted per chat and injected into the system prompt under a [Story Summary] label, separate from Soul Memory
Four sync-depth modes that trade memory depth against VRAM/RAM usage: Full Sync, Soul Link, Mind Spark, Reflection Flow (diary only).
Soul Memory uses a semantic search model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings); without the model file, memory cannot search by meaning
Memory is isolated per character and per chat session via path parameters passed to SoulMemoryAgent
Retrieve policy contrast: Soul Memory is distinguished from standard vector-RAG keyword log search
Lore injection modes: passive (background knowledge) vs active (system directive).

ledger.claim: On Russian-language input the current embedder (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) inverts similarity rankings, causing unrelated memories to score higher than related ones and injecting irrelevant fragments into character context — a continuity failure that appears as the model 'being dumb' rather than a technical fault
ledger.quote: На русском порядок перевёрнут — несвязанные предложения получили сходство выше, чем связанные... персонажу подставляются нерелевантные воспоминания, и выглядит это как «модель тупит», а не как техническая неисправность
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The failure affects a significant portion of users given the product has a Russian-language interface and a Russian-speaking audience
ledger.quote: Учитывая, что у программы русский интерфейс и русскоязычная аудитория, это задевает значительную часть пользователей
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Replacing the embedder with paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 (same 384-dim, same SentenceTransformer API) restores correct ranking for Russian and achieves 0.944 cross-lingual similarity for the same concept in Russian vs English, bridging user input to English-written memory files
ledger.quote: С английской моделью они не сопоставляются, с многоязычной — оказываются в одном смысловом пространстве... RU ↔ EN, одна мысль | 0.944
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: A continuity/generation failure occurs at version 2.5.0: after 3–4 turns, duplicated memory injection causes the model to output repetitive twin-responses, degrading character response coherence.
ledger.quote: after 3–4 turns of dialogue, the model's attention mechanism breaks down due to the duplicated prompt structure. The model falls into a severe repetition loop, outputting two or three identical variations of the same response in a single turn.
ledger.label: inferred
